articles.summary: Dole plc (NYSE: DOLE) (the “Company”) will announce its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on Monday, November 9, 2026, prior to the market opening. The Company’s management will host a webcast on the same day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. A presentation to accompany the discussion, along with a press release and other supplemental financial information, will be available at www.doleplc.com/investor-relations/financials . The live webcast and a replay after the event can be accessed at www.doleplc.com/investor-relations/events-and-presentations or directly at www.events.q4inc.com/attendee/145693531 . About Dole plc: A global leader in fresh produce, Dole plc grows, markets, and distributes an extensive variety of fresh fruits and vegetables sourced locally and from around the world. Dedicated and passionate in exceeding our customers’ requirements in over 85 countries, our goal is to make the world a healthier and more sustainable place. Category: Financial Investor Contact:
articles.title: Dole plc Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Release
